checklist.detail: codex --version reported codex-cli 0.146.0 immediately before the isolated run.
The real PtyConfig launch emitted --yolo; rollout context recorded approval_policy=never and danger-full-access.
The real launch emitted --model gpt-5.6-terra and -c model_reasoning_effort=medium; rollout context recorded both values.

The production argv emitted --no-alt-screen and the rollout cwd matched the isolated repository.
The root startup turn found no callable cs coordination/task tools and completed without either required call.

The production session could not reach a tool-capable follow-up. A diagnostic codex exec launch exposed both tools, isolating the failure to the interactive effective catalog rather than CAS stdio/env wiring.
The isolated worker loaded unique AGENTS.md and project-skill markers; the deterministic launch parity gate covers the synced Codex skill and agent catalogs.
Production config assertions covered CAS role/factory/session/model/effort env, and the native diagnostic whoami returned the isolated worker identity.
The existing real-Codex shipped Mux interrupt-and-inject proof completed the redirected turn and a later normal turn under --yolo.
PtyConfig emitted no rollout budget override, and real Codex turns completed without a rollout-token-budget abort.
